findings.quote: `public.my_context()` returns memberships in every status except `disabled` (G11 relies on `membership_status = 'pending'` appearing there)
findings.problem: The whole pending-membership design (5.6a tests (2)/(3), 5.6c's `resolveEntryRoute`, 5.7c DM-14) rests on two facts the prompt only asks the agent to 'confirm': that `my_context()` lists `pending` memberships and that `app.member_org_ids()` counts ONLY `active` ones. PLAN §4 does not state either. If 1.3 built them differently the agent has no instruction, cannot edit 9999, and 5.6c breaks silently.
findings.fix: Add to Build 1 (5): 'If `public.my_context()` omits `pending` memberships, or `app.member_org_ids()` (and any helper the read policies use) counts `pending` ones, redefine that function in THIS file with `create or replace` and the identical signature (no drop) so pending memberships are visible in `my_context()` but grant no reads; add the fact to the header comment and to the HANDOFF Deviations.' Make test (3) 'Pending grants nothing' explicitly the guard for this.
